question: The pre-monsoon showers are known as ________ in Kerala and Karnataka.
solution:
The correct answer is **mango showers**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mango showers** are pre-monsoon showers experienced in Kerala and Karnataka.
 
• These showers are crucial for the ripening of mangoes, hence the name.
 
• They typically occur from March to May.
